country.match: Match each sauce to the country it comes from.
country.odd: Three of these sauces come from {value}. Which one doesn't?

rows.label: bolognese sauce
rows.hook: is a slow-cooked meat ragù built on a base of onion, celery and carrot

rows.label: Worcestershire sauce
rows.hook: was invented by two pharmacists and is a fermented condiment bottled by Lea & Perrins

rows.label: sriracha sauce
rows.hook: is a hot red chili-and-garlic condiment made with distilled vinegar and sugar

rows.label: pico de gallo
rows.hook: is a fresh, chunky salsa of chopped tomato, onion and chili whose name means rooster's beak

rows.label: ranch dressing
rows.hook: is a creamy buttermilk-and-herb topping that is the top-selling choice for salads

rows.label: tzatziki
rows.description: cold cucumber-yogurt dip, soup, or sauce
rows.hook: is a cold yogurt-and-cucumber mix with garlic and dill, served as a meze

rows.label: guacamole
rows.description: Mexican avocado-based dip, spread, or salad
rows.hook: is a mashed avocado dip eaten with tortilla chips

rows.label: hoisin sauce
rows.description: thick, pungent sauce commonly used in Chinese cuisine as a glaze for meat
rows.hook: is a thick, dark, sweet-and-salty glaze for meat that also works as a dipping condiment

rows.label: soy sauce
rows.hook: is a salty umami liquid condiment fermented from beans and roasted grain

rows.label: Tabasco sauce
rows.hook: is a vinegar-based hot condiment bottled by the McIlhenny family on Avery Island, Louisiana

rows.label: Thousand Island dressing
rows.hook: is a pink mayonnaise-and-ketchup condiment with chopped pickles, popular on fast-food burgers

rows.label: hollandaise sauce
rows.hook: is a rich butter-and-egg-yolk emulsion that tops eggs Benedict

rows.label: chutney
rows.description: condiments associated with South Asian cuisine
rows.hook: is a sweet-and-tangy fruit or herb condiment, with mango the best-known kind

rows.label: tartar sauce
rows.hook: is a mayonnaise-and-pickle condiment served with fried fish

rows.label: pesto
rows.description: sauce made from basil, pine nuts, Parmigiano Reggiano, olive oil, and garlic
rows.hook: is a green paste of basil, pine nuts, cheese and olive oil that dresses pasta

rows.label: teriyaki
rows.hook: is a glossy glaze of soy, mirin and sugar brushed on grilled foods
